chain_words.nuance: ordinary tiredness after a normal day
tiredness that has lasted for a long time and feels burdensome
tiredness caused by physical or mental strain, often formal in tone
tiredness that leaves a person with no energy left
complete loss of energy, as if all strength had been removed

explanation: These words all express tiredness but with increasing intensity, from ordinary weariness after a normal day to a complete loss of energy.

usage_notes.difference: 'Tired' describes a normal, temporary state that rest can easily fix; 'exhausted' describes a much stronger state in which a person has no energy left at all.
